firmware_setup: HP: press F10 at power-on for the BIOS setup.
boot_menu: HP: press F9 at power-on for the boot device menu.
secure_boot: BIOS setup (F10) -> Advanced -> Secure Boot Configuration -> disable Secure Boot.
notes: Google's own kernel with the xe graphics driver; the profile adds the display options, firmware, audio
configuration, charger (ac.ko), CS35L41 speaker and internal camera (libcamera) support.
status: Physically tested since 2026-10-31: desktop, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, HDMI, audio, speakers, charger, internal camera.
